definition: Apptio provides business-management software for analyzing technology costs and relating spending to services and organizational units.
entry_text: Apptio provides business-management software for analyzing technology costs and relating spending to services and organizational units.
example: A finance partner allocates cloud spending across product teams for review.
label: Apptio

sources.note: IBM notes that Apptio TBM Studio models the relationship between IT costs and services and automates cost allocation; it identifies unit-level chargeback and service-level analysis as uses.
